map.PCR扩增曲线(Ct值)判读器 使用指南: PCR Amplification Curve (Ct Value) Interpreter User Guide
map.输入 Ct 值判读扩增阴阳性，支持定性/定量 PCR 分析与标准曲线计算未知样本: Enter a Ct value to interpret amplification as positive or negative, supporting qualitative and quantitative PCR analysis and standard-curve calculation of unknown sample concentrations for interpreting molecular test reports.
map.新冠/流感等核酸报告 Ct 值理解（如 Ct 25 较 Ct 38 载量更高）。: Understanding Ct values in COVID/flu nucleic acid reports (for example a Ct of 25 implies a higher load than a Ct of 38).
map.灰区（接近 cutoff）结果的风险提示与复测建议。: Risk notice and retest advice for gray-zone results (close to the cutoff).
map.教学演示扩增效率与 Ct 的关系。: Teaching demo of the relation between amplification efficiency and Ct.
map.：报告 Ct 28、cutoff 40，低于阈值为阳性且载量中等；若 Ct 39: The report shows Ct 28 against a cutoff of 40; below the threshold it is positive with a moderate load. A Ct of 39 is near the cutoff, so it is a gray zone and retesting or clinical correlation is advised.
map.Ct 值能定量病毒量吗？: Can the Ct value quantify the viral load?
map.只能粗略反映，精确定量需标准曲线与已知浓度；不同平台 Ct 不可直接比。: It only reflects things roughly; accurate quantification needs standard curves and known concentrations, and Ct values from different platforms are not directly comparable.
map.阳性就有传染性吗？: Does a positive result mean it is contagious?
map.不一定，Ct 高可能提示低载量或残留核酸，传染性由病程与症状综合判断。: Not necessarily; a high Ct may indicate a low viral load or residual nucleic acid, and infectivity must be judged from the disease course and symptoms together.
map.能替代核酸报告吗？: Can it replace the nucleic acid report?
map.不能，本工具仅解释 Ct 含义，结果以实验室为准。: No. This tool only explains what Ct means, and the lab result governs.
